ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm (Seashell Blizzard / APT44) HermeticWiper EaseUS kernel driver install for raw disk wipe
ucs.description: Hunts installation of the signed EaseUS Partition Master kernel driver (empntdrv.sys / epmntdrv.sys / EaseUS_<rand>.sys) outside the legitimate EaseUS installer. Sandworm's HermeticWiper, IsaacWiper and CaddyWiper families drop this driver, register it as a kernel service with a randomised name and call IOCTLs against it to overwrite physical drives — a behaviour effectively unique to GRU Unit 74455's destructive-attack tradecraft against Ukrainian and allied targets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_hash) as file_hash values(Filesystem.process_guid) as process_guid from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="*\\drivers\\*" AND (Filesystem.file_name="empntdrv.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="epmntdrv.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="EaseUS_*.sys") by host Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | join type=outer process_guid [| tstats summariesonly=t values(Processes.process_name) as parent_process values(Processes.process_path) as parent_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes by Processes.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | where NOT match(parent_path,"(?i)EaseUS|epm\.exe|epm64\.exe") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let SandwormWiperHashes = dynamic([
    "0385eeab00e946a302b24a91dea4187c1210597b8e17cd9e2230450f5ece21da",
    "1bc44eef75779e3ca1eefb8ff5a64807dbc942b1e4a2672d77b9f6928d292591",
    "3c557727953a8f6b4788984464fb77741b821991acbf5e746aebdd02615b1767",
    "2c7732da3dcfc82f60f063f2ec9fa09f9d38d5cfbe80c850ded44de43bdb666d"
]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\System32\drivers\", @"\SysWOW64\drivers\")
| where FileName in~ ("empntdrv.sys","epmntdrv.sys")
   or FileName matches regex @"(?i)^EaseUS_[0-9a-f]+\.sys$"
   or SHA256 in (SandwormWiperHashes)
| where InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName !contains "CHENGDU YIWO"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("epm.exe","epm64.exe","easeus.exe","easeuspartitionmaster.exe","msiexec.exe")
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where ActionType in ("ServiceInstalled","DriverLoad")
) on DeviceId
| where Timestamp1 between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 10m)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$" or InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ "system"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          DroppedDriver = FileName, DriverPath = FolderPath, SHA256,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentCompany = InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
          ServiceEventTime = Timestamp1, ServiceAction = ActionType1
| order by Timestamp desc

let SandwormWiperHashes = dynamic([
    "0385eeab00e946a302b24a91dea4187c1210597b8e17cd9e2230450f5ece21da",
    "1bc44eef75779e3ca1eefb8ff5a64807dbc942b1e4a2672d77b9f6928d292591",
    "3c557727953a8f6b4788984464fb77741b821991acbf5e746aebdd02615b1767",
    "2c7732da3dcfc82f60f063f2ec9fa09f9d38d5cfbe80c850ded44de43bdb666d"
]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4697
| extend SvcFile = tolower(ServiceFileName)
| where SvcFile has_any ("empntdrv.sys","epmntdrv.sys")
    or SvcFile matches regex @"easeus_[0-9a-f]+\.sys"
| extend RandomServiceName = ServiceName matches regex @"^[A-Za-z0-9]{4,8}$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ServiceName, ServiceFileName, ServiceType, ServiceStartType, ServiceAccount, RandomServiceName
| union (
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\System32\drivers\", @"\SysWOW64\drivers\")
    | where TargetFileName in~ ("empntdrv.sys","epmntdrv.sys")
        or TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)^EaseUS_[0-9a-f]+\.sys$"
        or TargetFileSHA256 in (SandwormWiperHashes)
    | where ActingProcessName !contains "easeus" and ActingProcessName !contains "epm.exe"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer = DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetFilePath, TargetFileName, TargetFileSHA256, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Sandworm HermeticWiper EaseUS Kernel Driver Install
id: 8b3f1c2d-4a5e-46c8-9b7d-ea9c8d4f3b21
status: experimental
description: Detects installation of the EaseUS Partition Master signed kernel driver (empntdrv.sys / epmntdrv.sys / EaseUS_<random>.sys) by a non-EaseUS process. The driver is registered as a Windows service and abused by Sandworm/Seashell Blizzard wipers (HermeticWiper, IsaacWiper, CaddyWiper) to issue raw IOCTLs that overwrite physical disks.
references:
    - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa22-057a
    - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2022/02/24/hermeticwiper-new-data-wiping-malware-hits-ukraine/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0034/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/01/15
tags:
    - attack.impact
    - attack.t1485
    - attack.t1561.001
    - attack.t1543.003
    - attack.g0034
logsource:
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:
    selection_known_names:
        EventID: 4697
        ServiceFileName|contains:
            - 'empntdrv.sys'
            - 'epmntdrv.sys'
    selection_random_name:
        EventID: 4697
        ServiceFileName|re: '(?i)EaseUS_[0-9a-f]+\.sys'
    condition: selection_known_names or selection_random_name
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate IT-driven installation of EaseUS Partition Master (verify by signer / installer parent)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) ((@EventID:4697 AND (@ServiceFileName:(*\\empntdrv.sys OR *\\epmntdrv.sys OR *\\EMPNTDRV.SYS OR *\\EPMNTDRV.SYS) OR @ServiceFileName:(*\\EaseUS_* OR *\\easeus_*))) OR (@EventID:11 AND @TargetFilename:(*\\System32\\drivers\\empntdrv.sys OR *\\System32\\drivers\\epmntdrv.sys OR *\\System32\\drivers\\EMPNTDRV.SYS OR *\\System32\\drivers\\EPMNTDRV.SYS OR *\\System32\\drivers\\EaseUS_* OR *\\System32\\drivers\\easeus_*))) -@Image:(*\\EaseUS* OR *\\easeus* OR *\\epm.exe OR *\\EPM.EXE OR *\\epm64.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=FileWritten OR #event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate)
| TargetFileName=/\\(System32|SysWOW64)\\drivers\\(empntdrv|epmntdrv|EaseUS_[0-9a-f]+)\.sys$/i OR RegStringValue=/empntdrv\.sys|epmntdrv\.sys|EaseUS_[0-9a-f]+\.sys/i
| ContextImageFileName!=/\\(EaseUS|epm(64)?\.exe|msiexec\.exe)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, ContextProcessId, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: The EaseUS Partition Master kernel driver pair (empntdrv.sys / epmntdrv.sys) is the destructive primitive shared across Sandworm's wiper arsenal documented by CISA AA22-057A, ESET (HermeticWiper / IsaacWiper) and Mandiant (APT44). ucs.title: [LLM] Sandworm (Voodoo Bear) mass wiper / lateral-tool fan-out via SMB push from a single staging host
ucs.description: Hunts the simultaneous appearance of an identical executable hash on many endpoints over SMB by a SYSTEM / machine-account writer within minutes — the deployment pattern used by Sandworm to detonate HermeticWiper, CaddyWiper, AcidRain-staging tools and Industroyer2 across Ukrainian targets, typically via a compromised domain controller pushing to ADMIN$/C$ or via GPO SYSVOL distribution. Distinct from single-host malware drops, this catches the synchronous destructive event Sandworm is famous for.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime dc(Filesystem.dest) as host_count values(Filesystem.dest) as hosts values(Filesystem.user) as writers from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created (Filesystem.user="SYSTEM" OR Filesystem.user="*$") (Filesystem.file_name="*.exe" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.bat" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.cmd") (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Windows\\System32\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\SYSVOL\\*") by Filesystem.file_hash Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where host_count >= 5 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let TimeBucket = 10m;
let FanoutThreshold = 5;
let StagingPaths = dynamic([@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Windows\System32\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Windows\SysWOW64\", @"\Windows\Tasks\", @"\SYSVOL\"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName =~ "system" or InitiatingProcessAccountName endswith "$"
| where (FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll" or FileName endswith ".sys" or FileName endswith ".bat" or FileName endswith ".cmd")
| where FolderPath has_any (StagingPaths)
| where FolderPath !has @"\WindowsUpdate\" and FolderPath !has @"\SoftwareDistribution\" and FolderPath !has @"\Servicing\"
| extend Bucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBucket)
| summarize FirstWrite=min(Timestamp), LastWrite=max(Timestamp),
            HostCount=dcount(DeviceName),
            Hosts=make_set(DeviceName, 25),
            SourceIPs=make_set(RequestSourceIP, 15),
            SourceHosts=make_set(RequestAccountName, 15),
            FileNames=make_set(FileName, 10)
            by SHA256, FolderPath, Bucket
| where HostCount >= FanoutThreshold
| where isnotempty(SHA256)
| order by HostCount desc, FirstWrite desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let TimeBucket = 10m;
let FanoutThreshold = 5;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType in~ ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where ActorUsername endswith "$" or ActorUsername in~ ("SYSTEM","NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
| where TargetFileExtension in~ ("exe","dll","sys","bat","cmd")
| where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\Windows\System32\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\SYSVOL\")
| where TargetFilePath !has @"\WindowsUpdate\" and TargetFilePath !has @"\SoftwareDistribution\"
| extend Bucket = bin(TimeGenerated, TimeBucket)
| summarize FirstWrite=min(TimeGenerated), LastWrite=max(TimeGenerated),
            HostCount=dcount(DvcHostname),
            Hosts=make_set(DvcHostname, 25),
            FileNames=make_set(TargetFileName, 10)
            by TargetFileSHA256, TargetFilePath, Bucket
| where HostCount >= FanoutThreshold
| where isnotempty(TargetFileSHA256)
| order by HostCount desc, FirstWrite desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:11 OR @EventID:4663) (@TargetFilename:(*\\Windows\\Temp\\*.exe OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\*.dll OR *\\Windows\\Temp\\*.sys OR *\\ProgramData\\*.exe OR *\\ProgramData\\*.dll OR *\\Users\\Public\\*.exe OR *\\PerfLogs\\*.exe OR *\\SYSVOL\\*.exe OR *\\Windows\\System32\\*.exe) OR @ObjectName:(*\\Windows\\Temp\\*.exe OR *\\ProgramData\\*.exe OR *\\Users\\Public\\*.exe OR *\\SYSVOL\\*.exe)) (@User:SYSTEM OR @User:*$ OR @SubjectUserName:SYSTEM OR @SubjectUserName:*$) -@TargetFilename:(*\\SoftwareDistribution\\* OR *\\WindowsUpdate\\* OR *\\Servicing\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\(Windows\\Temp|ProgramData|Users\\Public|PerfLogs|SYSVOL|Windows\\System32|Windows\\Tasks)\\.*\.(exe|dll|sys|bat|cmd)$/i
| UserName=/^(SYSTEM|.*\$)$/i
| TargetFileName!=/\\(SoftwareDistribution|WindowsUpdate|Servicing|WinSxS)\\/i
| groupBy([SHA256HashData, TargetFileName], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=HostCount), collect([aid, ComputerName], multival=true, limit=25), min(@timestamp, as=FirstWrite), max(@timestamp, as=LastWrite)])
| HostCount >= 5
